content: The American Diabetes Association (ADA) has conducted research into the cardiovascular effects of GLP-1 receptor agonists administered on a weekly basis. Clinical trials, including HARMONY Outcomes and ELIXA, have investigated these effects in detail. The findings from these studies have been mixed. In certain patient populations, the use of weekly GLP-1 receptor agonists was associated with a reduction in cardiovascular risk. However, the outcomes were not consistent across all groups and appeared to depend on factors such as the overall health status of the patients and the specific formulations of the GLP-1 receptor agonists used in the trials.
